test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word**
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is '**Whipe**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Whipe**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Wipe**'.
 
• It means 'to clean or dry something by rubbing it with a cloth, etc.' (कपड़े आदि से साफ़ करना या पोंछना)
 
 
• *Example: She stopped crying and **wiped **her eyes with a tissue.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:**__ *Wipe.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Wit**: the ability to use words in a clever and amusing way. (वाग्‍वैदग्‍ध्य, वाक्‌चातुर्य, हाज़िरजवाबी)
 
• **Wish**: to say to yourself that you want something that can only happen by good luck or chance. [किसी वस्‍तु की अभिलाषा या आशा करना (ऐसी इच्‍छा रखना जो भाग्‍य से या संयोगवश ही पूरी हो सकती हो)]
 
• **Witch**: (in past times and in stories) a woman who is thought to have magic powers. [(पूर्व समय और कहानियों में) जादूगरनी, टोनहाई या जादू-टोना करने वाली स्‍त्री]
 
 

40:Tae8,

The correct answer is '**Wisedom**'.
